display.purpose: Silkscreen for system headings, app labels and buttons.

body.purpose: Fira Code for readable prose, data, skill names and navigation.

shadows.name: window-offset
shadows.purpose: Small application-frame depth; not general card elevation.

motion.name: boot
motion.purpose: Skip-able local startup, once per session; absent under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No animations, cursor accent or smooth scrolling.

components.name: System Window
components.description: Application frame with filename, readable content, and optional real minimize/restore.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Square amber control, native semantics, visible focus and subtle pressed state.

components.name: Project Directory
components.description: Native selection buttons update a readable project preview; mobile scrolls to that preview.

narrative.overview: An original personal frontend operating system. Clear content first; system metaphor in presentation, navigation states and purposeful interactions. Amber, off-white, restrained CRT and pixel display typography combine with readable technical prose.
keyCharacteristics: Clear page names and role/framework identity.
Session-only boot and native accessible dialogs.
Persistent active-route taskbar and mobile menu.
Different application layouts for each content type.
Verified diagrams, original PDF and preserved email backend.

rules.name: Readable System
rules.body: Do not hide essential content behind hover, typing, motion or fictitious commands.

rules.name: Protected Functionality
rules.body: Preserve Resend validation, reply-to, honeypot, WhatsApp encoding and original CV.

rules.name: Restrained CRT
rules.body: Use lighter effects on mobile and reduced motion; offer an actual CRT-off control.
